assign.title: Servex: file and shell tools for the voice app
assign.outcome: **The voice app can read, write and edit files and run shell commands once Servex restarts.** Six tools (read_file, write_file, edit_file, list_dir, glob, shell) sit in the one Servex tool registry, rooted at the monorepo or a named worktree; .jsonl writes are refused and pointed at append.mjs. A generic call({tool, args}) tool keeps its schema fixed, so new tools should need no new app approval (untested in the app). Merged as dbb98d9de.
